description: No security measures to ensure electronically transmitted ePHI is not improperly modified without detection.
applicability: This signal applies to: Electronic health record (EHR) systems Health information exchanges (HIEs) Patient portals and healthcare applications Database systems containing ePHI Network infrastructure transmitting ePHI Cloud services hosting healthcare data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review network transmission protocols and security measures for ePHI transfers. Check for integrity verification mechanisms such as message authentication codes (MACs), digital signatures, or secure protocols (TLS/SSL) that include integrity checking. Verify that file transfers, API communications, and messaging systems implement tamper detection.
